Description:
Hi there!

Please meet the Cutie Mark Chooksaders: Apple Bwawk, Clucky Belle and Voidaloo!

Please have a look at the read-me file included in the zip file to find out where to put the files and what files you may need to make back-ups for.

If you've got any questions or suggestions, please let me know. :D

(Please also be aware that Sweetie Belle's chicken counterpart still uses the same baby chicken skin as the original, but that's because the same skin is also used by the baby duck and it's hardcoded that way, so there's no way I can change one without changing the other. Maybe in the future, in which case I'll have a Sweetie Belle chick skin all set and ready to go. xD)
